manual.title: UE Boom
manual.description: Enter the Bluetooth address of your UE Boom speaker.

trusted_mac.title: Trusted device
trusted_mac.description: Enter the MAC address of a device authorized to turn the speaker on/off remotely (speaker: {address}). This is typically the Bluetooth MAC of the phone you paired in the UE Boom app's "Remote power on" setting — on iOS find it in Settings → General → About → Bluetooth.

device_not_found.message: UE Boom speaker {address} was not found via Bluetooth. {reason}
